why_zlib_is_still_pinned: Neither official candidate ships zlib 1.4-r0: both carry their Alpine base layer's 1.3.2-r1. Alpine's v3.22 security database lists CVE-2026-4738 as fixed in 1.4-r0. The pin fails closed with HTTP 404 when Alpine publishes a newer zlib revision; drop it once an official Redis 7.4 image ships zlib 1.4-r0 or later.
server_and_cli_source: Inherited unchanged from the exact parent; server/CLI/entrypoint SHA256 equality with the parent verified on linux/arm64 and on emulated linux/amd64.

parent_already_fixed_primary_ids.basis: The ten OpenSSL IDs that 3.3.7-r2 backported on v3.21 are fixed upstream in OpenSSL 3.5.9 per the 2026-09-29 OpenSSL advisory, and the parent ships 3.5.9-r0. CVE-2026-85091 is fixed in the parent's zlib 1.3.2-r1 per the vendor recipe. Alpine's v3.22 security database does not list the ten OpenSSL IDs under any 3.5 revision; this mapping rests on the upstream advisory, not on a scan.

open_branch_fixes_not_applied.upstream_severity: Low for all seven (OpenSSL vulnerabilities page, checked 2026-11-27); upstream fix is OpenSSL 3.5.10
open_branch_fixes_not_applied.affected_code: QUIC, AES-GCM-SIV, CMS_encrypt() and PEM_X509_INFO_read_bio_ex() with a caller-supplied stack
open_branch_fixes_not_applied.reason_not_pinned: The official image (built 2026-11-09) predates both revisions. Pinning them would add four more mirror URLs on a package that is revised often (3.5.10 is the announced upstream fix), recreating the 404 failure this rebase removes. Redis does not use QUIC or CMS and OpsPilot runs Redis without TLS; that is a reading of the advisories, not a function-level analysis.

support_limit: Alpine 3.22 main support ends 2027-05-01 (alpinelinux.org/releases.json). Redis 7.4.12 is the current 7.4 patch release on 2026-11-27. Recheck before that date and before any publication.
licensing: Redis 7.4 parent retains RSALv2 or SSPLv1; project MIT does not relicense the server. OpenSSL Apache-2.0 and zlib license texts preserved. No image redistribution/publication performed.
